# Incorporating Your Company with Rho

Last updated:

Rho can incorporate your company for you, as a Delaware C-corp or an LLC, filed on your behalf. Delaware C-corp formation documents are reviewed and approved by a licensed attorney. Most founders finish the flow in about 5 minutes, and roughly 80% of C-corp filings complete within 24 hours.

## What does incorporation with Rho include?

 Delaware certificate of incorporation, filed for you
 Your EIN application (Form SS-4) submitted to the IRS
 Attorney review and approval of Delaware C-corp formation documents
 Registered-agent service, included for the first year

## What does it cost?

Rho incorporates your Delaware C corp for $400.

LLC: $349 all in, state filing fee included.

## What are the requirements? [...] ## What are the requirements?

 At least one U.S.-based owner or officer
 A physical U.S. operating address
 Rho Incorporation forms Delaware C-corps and LLCs

## Can I open a Rho account before I have an EIN?

Yes. Rho supports pre-EIN onboarding, so you can start banking while your EIN application is in progress. International founders without a U.S. SSN or TIN are supported too — expect a longer EIN timeline from the IRS.

## When do I get my documents?

For a Delaware C-corp, Rho files your Delaware certificate first, then submits your EIN application. About 80% of C-corp filings complete within 24 hours; the EIN follows on the IRS's timeline.

## What Rho Incorporation includes

The Delaware C-corp is $400 and the LLC is $349 all in, with the state filing fee included for the LLC. Both include the filing itself, registered agent service for your first year, your EIN application prepared and submitted, and a Rho business account application in the same flow. The difference is the document set and timeline. An LLC is filed in the state you choose, with approvals typically coming back in about 2–3 days depending on that state. A Delaware C-corp adds attorney review of every formation document, the full startup document set, and 83(b) election forms, and is typically filed within about 24 hours. [...] Rho Incorporation includes Delaware C-corp formation for $400, reviewed by a licensed attorney, and LLC formation for $349 all in, filed on your behalf with the state filing fee included. Both include registered agent service for your first year, and your SS-4 (EIN application) is prepared and submitted for you. Your Rho business account application can open in the same flow, subject to approval, but funds cannot move until the IRS issues your EIN and it attaches to your account. Banking, invoicing, cards, and bill pay, all live the moment your account is approved.

results.content:
NEW YORK, Nov. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Rho, the modern banking platform built for the AI era, today announcedRho Incorporation, which lets founders form a Delaware C corporation or an LLC directly within the Rho application and apply for a Rho business account in the same flow.

A Delaware C corporation costs $400, including first-year registered agent service, and an LLC costs $349 all-in, including the state filing fee. Rho Incorporation is available now atrho.co/product/incorporation. [...] Delaware C corp: $400

Built for founders who plan to raise venture capital. Founders receive the full formation set, including the certificate of incorporation, bylaws, board consents, stock purchase agreements, and 83(b) election support. Registered agent service is included for the first year, and the SS-4 (EIN application) is prepared and submitted on the founder's behalf.

LLC: $349 all-in

Built for founders who don't plan to raise venture capital, including agencies, consultancies, e-commerce shops, creators, and freelancers. The state filing fee is included, and founders canform in any of the 50 states. State approval typically takes two to three business days, depending on the state, and the SS-4 (EIN application) is prepared and submitted on the founder's behalf. [...] Opening a business account before the EIN arrives

Incorporation and banking normally run in sequence: a company is formed, then waits on its EIN before it can apply for an account. With Rho, the business account application runs in parallel with EIN processing, subject to approval. Banking, invoicing, cards, and bill pay are live the moment the account is approved. Pricing is current as of the date of this release and is subject to change.

Availability is limited to standard LLC formations andstandard Delaware C corporation formations. Non-standard equity splits, custom vesting schedules, and board or voting modifications are handled outside the standard flow. Delaware's own processing time varies with the state's queue and has recently run two to four business days.

## Key Takeaways

 Rho announced Rho Incorporation in a release datelined New York, 4 November 2026.
 A Delaware C corp costs $400, including first-year registered agent service; an LLC costs $349, including the state filing fee, per Rho.
 LLCs can be formed in any of the 50 US states; C corps are offered in Delaware only.
 Rho’s release says Delaware processing has recently taken 2 to 4 business days; its product page says about 80% of C corp filings complete within about 24 hours.
 Funds in a new Rho business account cannot move until the IRS issues the EIN and it attaches to the account, Rho says.

## What Rho Incorporation does [...] ## Final Thoughts

Rho Incorporation joins company formation and the Rho business account application in one flow. Rho has published prices of $400 for a Delaware C corp and $349 for an LLC, and says it prepares the EIN application for founders.

What remains unsettled is timing. Rho’s release and website give different figures for Delaware filings, and the business account cannot move money until the IRS issues an EIN. Founders comparing options can also check Rho’s current terms on registered agent renewal, partner banks and eligibility. More coverage is in the Scommerce fintech news section.
